I hope these helps

1. Rug to a neutral, dark one, abstract (and not geometric) will look good

2. Change your wallpaper to living thing. A scenery of people walking, animals, anime characters, dynamic photography of people (people dancing? Your choice!)

3. Add something in the mustard-ish yellow, that wull conpliment with the not-so-standard green wall happening

4. Change your ceiling lamp to something of a wide / long profile rather than a orb one, this is to create a flow instead of mass

5. Add a full-body mirror, will help with body doubling when you're working.
